name: fabric-agent-adapter
description: Adapt existing agent projects to the versioned Fabric Agent Contract with evidence-backed MCP, A2A, or local-runner provider bundles.

plugins.name: fabric-agent-adapter
plugins.description: Inspects an existing agent, API, MCP server, A2A peer, or terminal CLI; selects one Fabric profile per capability; scaffolds a contract-pinned provider bundle; and separates declaration, protocol, semantic, and binding-readiness verdicts.
